{{Top|leg}}
The '''First Galactic Bank of Ord Mantell''' was a [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Mantellian]] financial institution during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:AF">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Appropriating Funds|Tatooine}}</ref> After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], a spacer killed the [[White Thranta Shipping Company|White Thranta]] criminal [[Durr Roddack]]<ref name="SWG:SO">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Shipping Out|Tatooine}}</ref> and transferred all the content of Roddack's bank account, in the [[First Imperial Bank]] of Core, to his own, in the First Galactic Bank of Ord Mantell.<ref name="SWG:AF" />
